dct_title_s: HOTOSM Christmas Island Financial Services (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: OpenStreetMap exports for use in GIS applications. This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching: amenity IN ('mobile_money_agent','bureau_de_change','bank','microfinance','atm','sacco','money_transfer','post_office') Features may have these attributes: - [operator](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:operator) - [addr:full](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:full) - [addr:city](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:addr:city) - [network](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:network) - [amenity](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity) - [source](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source) - [name](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name) This dataset is one of many [OpenStreetMap exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot). See the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](http://hotosm.org/) website for more information.
